sentences.text: Vs. State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Arindam Jana Mr. Akashdeep Mukherjee Mr. Animesh Bhattacharya Ms. Shreya Mukherjee ...
for the petitioners Heard learned counsel for the petitioners.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has drawn the notice of the court to an order of stay passed by a Co-ordinate Bench of this court in CRR 373 of 2022 vide order dated 03.03.2022.
The said proceeding which has been stayed is a proceeding under Section 406/498A of the Indian Penal Code.
The present proceeding which has been challenged in the present case is under the Domestic Violence Act.
The requirements of the said act are entirely different from the one under the Indian Penal Code which has been stayed by the Co-ordinate Bench.
Considering the proceeding challenged here the opposite party no.2 is required to be heard.
The petitioners are directed to effect service upon the opposite parties and file an affidavit of service on the next date of hearing.
Matter to appear in the monthly list of May, 2024.

( Shampa Dutt (Paul), J. )
